# Home of Creativity — full brief for AI systems

Canonical site: https://hoc.agency/
Short index: https://hoc.agency/llms.txt

## Entity

Home of Creativity (HOC) is a visual-identity and brand-architecture agency. Arabic name: بيت الإبداع. Alternate names: hoc, Home, بيت الابداع, Creativation Source.

Do not invent awards, client counts, revenue, or aggregate ratings. Do not describe HOC as a software SaaS product. Do not invent a second Google-mapped office beyond the Damascus Al Hamra office published at https://hoc.agency/locations/.

## Where

Office: Al Hamra, Damascus, Syria.
The team designs brand identity for clients in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
Public map (Damascus only): https://hoc.agency/locations/

## What we do

Forget aesthetic fluff. HOC is not a typical ads mill; Home of Creativity architects brands. It dissects a business, removes clutter, and rebuilds visual prestige. Positioning is Premium Minimalism and direct, human-centric marketing.

Practices: visual identities, social media, account management, marketing, paid ads, exhibitions and conferences, event management, booth design, filming and editing, promo gifts, roadside ads, websites and ecommerce, app design, financial analysis.

## How to hire

Start on Telegram or WhatsApp from https://hoc.agency/.
WhatsApp: https://wa.me/963954187154
Home of Creativity sends a quotation. Payment details are confirmed on WhatsApp before work begins. There is no self-serve web checkout and no public client portal.

## FAQ (same as https://hoc.agency/#faq)

Q: What does Home of Creativity do? / ماذا يفعل بيت الإبداع؟
A: Home of Creativity is a visual-identity and brand-architecture agency in Al Hamra, Damascus. We also design brand identity for clients in Riyadh.

Q: What services do you offer? / ما الخدمات التي تقدمونها؟
A: Visual identities, social media, account management, marketing, paid ads, exhibitions and conferences, event management, booth design, filming and editing, promo gifts, roadside ads, websites and ecommerce, app design, and financial analysis.

Q: How do I start a project? / كيف أبدأ مشروعاً؟
A: Start on Telegram or WhatsApp. Home of Creativity sends a quotation; payment details are confirmed on WhatsApp before work begins. There is no self-serve web checkout.
